race.description: 10 Years Of Racing Mates Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BANNER BANNER (11) turned in a decent effort two back over this course and distance then disappointed last start. Lovely draw and gets the winkers on for the first time. No surprise if he turned things around. STRIKE A POSE (1) is back after a six-month spell. Mixed his form in the four-run maiden campaign when largely unwanted by the market. Recent trial winner who looks set to improve this time in work. The speedy DWIGHT (4) raced handy all the way and just failed to hang on over 1100m at Bathurst recently. Ran well over 1250m at Newcastle two back so this set-up is okay. ARTFULL (8) ran a cheeky race at odds here last time and can improve further at the third run back.
